subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Entail
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"entail"** means to involve something as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence. (आवश्यक करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The project will** entail **a lot of hard work and dedication.
 
 
 
• **"Necessitate" **refers to making something necessary as a result or consequence. (अनिवार्य बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The severe weather conditions **necessitate** extra precautions.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'entail' **is **'necessitate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Assume **(मान लेना): To take for granted or without proof.

 
 
• **Example:** I assume he will be coming to the meeting today.
 
 
 
• **Eliminate **(निकालना): To remove or get rid of.
 
 
• **Example: **We need to eliminate all the errors from the report.
 
 
 
• **Flaw** (त्रुटि): A fault or weakness in a system or design.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a flaw in your argument that needs to be addressed.
 
 

39:Tdec,

The correct answer is: **Option 3)**
